items.title: Horizontal Brick Dash DXF Pattern for Minimalist Screens
items.description: Horizontal rows of rectangles and short bars stagger across the panel in a barcode-like, brick-laid rhythm. The sharp, orderly repetition suits industrial-style fences and simple architectural dividers.

items.title: Minimalist Fluid Vines Symmetrical Scroll CNC Art
items.description: Move away from complex grids with this beautiful, minimalist vector composition featuring fluid, symmetrical vines and stylized calligraphic scrollwork with elegant circular accents. Prepared flawlessly in production-ready DXF, SVG, and DWG formats, this scenic nature-inspired art is tailored for artistic metal plasma cutting, CNC wood routing, and custom laser-cut wall murals. Perfect for beautifying luxury metal garden gates, residential fences, courtyards, and sophisticated interior feature walls.
